title: The Promise of Restoration and Zion's Future
description: Despite Zion's complaint that the Lord has forgotten her, God assures him that he will never forget his people—he has engraved Zion on the palms of his hands. He promises that children will return from exile, that kings and queens will be foster fathers and nurses for Zion's children, and that even the captives of the mighty will be freed [ref:Jes 49:8-26|Isaiah 49:8-26].
